response.original_title: [[Faq-Guest-Addition]] How can I add a guest to my MSC cruise?
response.overview: You must call MSC Cruise or your travel agent to add a guest to a cabin; +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) this requires a manual check of the ship's lifeboat capacity. To add Guests to a MSC Cruise, you must call MSC Cruise directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. To add a Guest to an existing MSC cruise booking +1-866-829-1280 , please contact Customer Service at a +1-866-829-1280 (US) or 44-204-586-5316 (UK) for assistance with checking state Guest availability and updating the reservation. A representative can guide you through the available options and provide 1-(866)-829-1280 (US) or & +44-204-586-5316(UK) information about applicable rates, Guest categories, and booking requirements. If the reservation was made through a travel advisor, please contact the advisor for further assistance.
